TAL_ATHLETICS_ROPE_SWING_ADEPT.reviewed_by: lane A2R23 2026-10-13: the attach (Bonus Action, asking for the anchor through the bounded choice transport), the free detach and the quick climb to the anchor are the engine's (combat/ext/athletics.py rope_swing); ending movement in the air while swinging is the flight seam (suspended)
riders: The anchor is any square above the fighter that it can see and land on: the printed text names no range, so sight is the bound.

"as though you possessed a temporary Fly Speed" gives no Fly Speed value, so none is invented: the engine's suspended capability is the printed clause (the fighter does not fall when it ends its move in the air), and no air travel the printed text does not grant.
The quick climb is movement: it charges the shared allowance the climb's distance, and the native landing gates still decide whether the anchor is a legal, unoccupied landing.

TAL_ATHLETICS_FLOWING_PURSUIT.reviewed_by: lane AUTO8 2026-10-04: the closing-distance trigger, the printed choice of one benefit and three of its four options are the engine's (combat/ext/athletics.py flowing_pursuit); the Opportunity Attack answer uses the shared opportunity_allowed seam, the +2 AC against one named creature the shared condition:typed.ac_against shape, and the jump the documented jump_bonus_ft seam

activation.trigger: When you move at least 20 feet toward one creature during your turn

effects.evidence: ignore Opportunity Attacks from that creature
gain +2 AC against that creature until the start of your next turn
add 5 feet to one jump during the movement

riders: The table asks which benefit when the movement that closed the 20 feet resolves, because that is the first point after a move at which a player may be asked: the Opportunity Attack answer then covers any further movement that turn, and the jump bonus covers a jump taken after the choice rather than a jump inside the movement already finished. "Move through one allied creature's space without treating it as difficult terrain" needs nothing: only hostile spaces are difficult on this table (combat/gate2_engine._hostile_difficult_cells), so it is not offered as a fourth button.

TAL_ATHLETICS_ONE_BREATH_TEN_THOUSAND_ST.reviewed_by: lane A2R23 2026-10-13: the printed Martial Focus return every 20 feet of movement (including a willing teleport) is the engine's (combat/ext/athletics.py one_breath); Opportunity Attack immunity is the opportunity_allowed seam, hostile spaces as difficult terrain the pass_through seam, walls/water/air/fragile surfaces the climbing and support_surface seams, the one attack the deferred strike buttons (combat/ext/athletics.py), and the once-per-activation Motion receipt the per-activation registry
riders: The one weapon attack or unarmed strike lands at the point of movement the fighter chooses: the activation's own attack row is compiled but deferred, and a free strike button is provided for each native weapon delivery the fighter can use (including a thrown delivery when available), plus the printed Unarmed Strike. Every button shares the one attack granted by this activation.

"Once per long rest" is not separately enforced: the table's use counter is per fight, not per rest (the owner-approved combat convention; the non-combat rest clock is map infrastructure this engine does not have).

"Apply any number of known Motion talents during the turn, but apply each Motion talent only once": the engine's Motion passives already apply on their own triggers, and the per-activation receipt (combat/ext/athletics.py motion_applied_once / record_motion_application) bounds each to once per activation, keyed by the exact Motion talent's owner id.

take Dash again without spending an Action
make one weapon attack or unarmed strike at any point during the movement
